limitations: All masses except nominal battery family rating are provisional estimates.
Chassis inertia uses a uniform collision box plus COM shift, not a measured inertia tensor.
Caster is an ideal ball with a spherical bearing constraint.
Tire friction, rolling drag, motor torque and camera FOV are assumed and require later measurement.
Reflected gearmotor inertia is approximated by uniform wheel inertia scaling to 0.0005 kg m2 on the free axle; this is not a measured motor model.
